## User problem

Who is blocked, and what should become possible?

## Proposed bounded scope

Include non-goals and any prerequisite work. For architecture changes, start with
a design discussion rather than a large implementation.

## Acceptance and testing

How will we know this works? Include compatibility, UX, security and resource
constraints as relevant. Performance proposals need a baseline and measurement plan.
